notes: Re-baselined for #247: the bundle-size guard now measures the desktop entry chunk alone (resolved via Vite's build manifest), not the sum of all emitted JS. The previous pre-#244 baseline of 121,576 B summed every JS file and was captured before the mobile component subtree shipped, which made the pre-split number incommensurable with the post-split entry-only contract. Pre-split entry chunk on the same git tree was 132,742 B gz; post-split entry is 126,009 B gz — a 6,733 B gz drop (5.07%) and a 23.84 KB drop in raw uncompressed JS, satisfying SC-001. The delta is attributable to removing CardList, MobileFilterBar, StickyPushBar, BottomSheetEditor, and DescriptionEditorScreen plus their @tanstack/react-virtual dependency from the desktop entry. The 15%-over budget here governs the desktop-only entry chunk. The mobile chunk and PWA chunks are listed in stdout for human review but do not gate CI.
